verdict.rationale: Notion's documentation shows creating and updating pages and databases and positions the product as 'one system of record' for work. Community users independently describe using it as a team wiki alongside task and project tracking, calling it a balance between strict PM tools and unstructured wikis. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-app sharing/permission and real-time co-editing features, and explicit documentation of how docs are organized (page hierarchy/linking to project items), since most first-party evidence is API-focused.
